system.name: ProtST
system.one_liner: Joint pre-training of a protein language model, a biomedical text model and a fusion module, used for supervised learning, zero-shot classification and retrieval.

content.variant_note: one pre-training panel, then three small downstream panels (supervised, zero-shot classification, retrieval) that reuse the same orange and blue language-model trapezoids
content.argues: Pre-training a protein language model jointly with a text model and a fusion module gives one pair of models that serves supervised learning, zero-shot classification and retrieval.
content.subject: ProtST pre-training on protein sequences and texts, and three uses of the result: supervised learning, zero-shot classification and retrieval.

evidence: (a) A protein language model (PLM) is first pre-trained along with a biomedical language model (BLM) and a fusion module
The paired PLM and BLM can also retrieve functional proteins from a large-scale database without any function annotation.

summary: ProtST pre-trains a protein language model (PLM) together with a biomedical language model (BLM) on protein sequences and their text descriptions, then uses the result in three ways. Figure 1 has four panels split by dashed lines and drawn with one colour per modality: orange for protein, blue for text. Panel (a) shows pre-training: a masked sequence and a masked description go through the Protein LM and Biomedical LM, a grey Fusion Module and four loss terms. Panel (b) uses the Protein LM alone for supervised classification. Panels (c) and (d) compare protein and text embeddings by dot products for zero-shot classification and for text-to-protein retrieval with ranked results.
summary_zh: ProtST 用蛋白质序列和文字描述联合预训练两个语言模型。图 1 分四个面板：(a) 预训练，含融合模块和四个损失；(b) 监督学习；(c) 零样本分类；(d) 零样本文本到蛋白质检索。橙色为蛋白质，蓝色为文本。
notes: The pre-screen said phase-bands; fan-out was chosen because one pre-training panel feeds three downstream uses (phase-bands would also fit). The loss symbols L_MPM, L_GC, L^S_MMP and L^T_MMP are not defined in the figure; their link to the three pre-training tasks named in the abstract is inferred from the subscripts, so element roles stay neutral. Which cell of the class list is shaded and why is not explained in the figure.
